annotations.title: Find live literature for a resolved public gene

description: Retrieve a live publication capture for a resolved gene_id and snapshot_id. Returns source links, match labels, capture time/hash, degradation and gene/snapshot/sort-bound cursors. This capture is separate from the immutable reference snapshot and contains no abstracts.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor returned for this same gene, snapshot and sort. Omit for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

gene_id.description: Canonical HGNC gene_id returned by resolve_gene. Select an explicit candidate when resolution is ambiguous.
gene_id.title: Gene Id

limit.description: Maximum publication records in one live discovery page, from 1 to 25.
limit.title: Limit

snapshot_id.description: identity_snapshot_id returned by resolve_gene, or snapshot_id from the current gene profile. Restart resolution after snapshot_unavailable.
snapshot_id.title: Snapshot Id

sort.description: Discovery ordering. Keep the same sort for continuation pages.
sort.title: Sort

name: search_gene_literature
title: Find live literature for a resolved public gene
